# PlateLine

> Training for electroplating, anodizing and metal finishing shops: RCRA generator and refresher, satellite accumulation, plant ERT, awareness and contingency planning, with F006, cyanide and pretreatment guides.

PlateLine (https://metal-finishing.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs RCRA Generator, Generator Refresher, Satellite Accumulation, Plant ERT or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://metal-finishing.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

Waste containers at the plating line. Enroll: https://metal-finishing.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-satellite-accumulation-area-training?buy=415
- [Manufacturing Emergency Response Team (ERT) Training](https://metal-finishing.hazwoperosha.us/courses/manufacturing-emergency-response-team-ert-training): $149.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). - [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://metal-finishing.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Contingency planning for large quantity generator shops. Enroll: https://metal-finishing.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training?buy=412

## Guides

- [F006 sludge and other electroplating wastes](https://metal-finishing.hazwoperosha.us/guides/f006-sludge-electroplating): The listed waste every plating shop makes, and what to do with it.
- [Cyanide and acids: why segregation matters in plating shops](https://metal-finishing.hazwoperosha.us/guides/cyanide-and-acids-plating): Mixing acids with cyanide releases hydrogen cyanide gas. The controls that prevent it.
- [Wastewater pretreatment and hazardous waste](https://metal-finishing.hazwoperosha.us/guides/pretreatment-and-hazardous-waste): How plating shops' wastewater rules and hazardous waste rules connect.
